channel.title: BTEUP CSE Hub — exam desk updates
channel.description: Exam calendar, admit cards, results and revaluation windows for BTEUP diploma CSE (lateral entry). Links go to the official portal only.

item.title: Odd-semester & special-back exams
item.description: Nov 17 – Dec 5, 2026 for diploma odd semesters and special back papers. Reach the centre 30 minutes early; carry the printed admit card and college ID. — Window: 2026-11-17 → 2026-12-05 — Official link: https://bteup.ac.in/PDFFILES/NEWS_639300327915482491.pdf

item.title: Odd-sem & special-back admit cards
item.description: Released Nov 12, 2026. Log in with your enrollment number and password, download the PDF and print 2 copies. Check your name, roll number and exam centre the same day — errors take days to fix. — Window: 2026-11-12 — Official link: https://bteup.ac.in/Eseva/Outerpages/StudentLogin.aspx

item.title: Odd-sem & special-back exam form
item.description: Closed on Oct 31, 2026. Missed it? Contact your college exam cell immediately — late submission goes through the college, not this site. — Window: 2026-10-24 → 2026-10-31

item.title: Revaluation / scrutiny window
item.description: Opens shortly after results, via your college with a per-subject fee. Decide within days of the marksheet — the window is short. Link will be added when the notice is out. — Window: to be announced

item.title: Odd-semester & special-back results
item.description: To be announced — BTEUP usually declares odd-sem results 4–6 weeks after exams end (expect Jan–Feb 2027). We add the direct portal link here the day it goes live; this news page is where it will surface first. — Window: to be announced — Official link: https://bteup.ac.in/webapp/AllNews.aspx
